interventions.detail: Sa2VA-1B (InternVL2.5) needs the 'legacy' uv extra; used documented `uv sync --extra=legacy` and downloaded the model (pinned revision) via hf download
Pass use_flash_attn=False to from_pretrained; the remote code enables FlashAttention2 whenever flash_attn imports, which fails on CPU
Make Tensor.cuda a no-op on CPU because the model's predict_forward hard-codes .cuda()
Cast the model to bf16 after loading; torch_dtype='auto' leaves some modules fp32, which mismatches the bf16 inputs
demo.py passed processor= to predict_forward, but InternVL-based Sa2VA-1B rejects it (TypeError); only pass it for Qwen models
Redirect SAM2's hard-coded torch.device('cuda') inference state and autocast('cuda') to CPU at runtime
Wrap predict_forward in torch.inference_mode(); SAM2 kept its autograd graph (~5GB/call), so 4 frames were OOM-killed under the 12GB limit
